about_the_game:
It's the end of days for this fringe terraforming colony... and you're the damage control. Play as Noah Gansky, a resourceful combat engineer armed only with his wits, his agility, and his Omniaxe. Fight your way through hordes of alien bugs, energy cultists, and professional super-soldiers as you try to save the people of Ross 128-b and escape the grasp of the Solar Dominion.


FEATURES



Jump, slide and dash your way to mastering your environment. Explore a deep world strewn with secrets, and survive the cataclysm of Ross-128b!




Outmaneuver your enemies, using the environment to your advantage. Unlock key upgrades for your arsenal, giving you more ways to exploit the enemy's weakness. Sustain your arsenal with fuel harvested from enemies with The Omniaxe!




Return to conquered areas with new tools, and reveal hidden challenges! Your weapons and abilities can also interact with the environment. Hit an electrical breaker box with an electric dart to restore power to an area, blast your way through hard alien goop with a charge shot, and break through walls with a dash attack!




Your enemies, weapons and environment are brought to life with unique hand-drawn sprite work. Sprite animations are drawn frame-by-frame, and brimming with fluid and expressive movement.

content_descriptors.notes: Blood, Gore, and Violence are commonly used in Relentless Frontier. People die, enemies that get shot bleed and occasionally explode. Authoritarian political implications, and some scenes of mass death may be shocking.

name: Relentless Frontier

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i3 2100 or higher
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 2GB of VRAM with OpenGL 3.3 (Geforce GTX 630 or higher)
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: These system requirements are subject to change.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i7 4790k or higher
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 8GB of VRAM with Vulkan support
  • Additional Notes: These system requirements are subject to change.

short_description: Relentless Frontier is a fast paced sci-fi FPS running on the GZDoom Engine, with a strong focus on mobility, strategy, and exploration. Use your Omnistruct to replicate new weapons and abilities to help you traverse the terrain and demolish threats, while escaping from Ross 128-b in one piece.
